property_summary: For any admissible timestamp, two fallback calls with 10 ether in the same timestamp must not both succeed, so c's balance can only grow by one 10-ether deposit per distinct timestamp; the mutant's >= guard lets both succeed and inflates address(c).balance to 30 ether.
change_summary: Change the timestamp guard from strictly greater to greater-or-equal, allowing multiple calls in the same block.
